script_text: Stop! Taurus, the stars are screaming at you right now. On November 5, 2026, Venus, your ruling planet, forms a tense square to Mars in your 7th House of Partnerships, while the Moon trines your 10th House of Career, creating friction that demands a choice. As a fixed Earth sign, Jupiter sextiles your 2nd House of Money, promising a hidden financial chance if you stop second-guessing. In love, if you're taken, that square warns of a stubborn argument with your partner tonight, so listen before you lock in. If you're single, a grounded Earth-to-Earth connection could appear through work, so keep your heart open. For career and money, Mercury's trine to your 10th House favors a negotiation or salary talk in your 2nd House before noon. Blessing: an unexpected gift or refund arrives, but avoid impulsive luxury spending. Follow for tomorrow's reading so you don't miss what's coming this week.
